status: declared by the pull request that closes #624 after step 1 was committed (docs/pivot/off-risk-day-result.md, docs/pivot/evidence/off-risk-day/) and before any score of a step 2 variant; a measurement, not a record. Nothing here is published: no variant joins any published declaration, no day after 2025-12-31 is scored, no rule changes and the live record and pin do not move. The variants were built after seeing 2018-2025, so a pass here is not a confirmation (ruling of 11 October 2026 on #567)

parent.from: metadata/satiation_distance_598.json, variant (a); its forecasts, on risk dates, are not changed

replaces: the constant 0 on a day that is not a risk date (announcement_dating_rescore.risk_flag(splits, values, True)); a risk date keeps the parent's forecast
step_one: docs/pivot/off-risk-day-result.md: the control's own inputs rank the days (AUROC 0.70 to 0.75 pooled, 0.65 to 0.70 inside 2018-19) and the cap and the constant floors do not; part of a trailing rate's pooled skill is the split between regimes

variant_rules.risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+offday: (a) a ridge logistic (ml.PRESSURE_LOGISTIC_SETTINGS: C = 1, standardized) of a pressure day at the threshold on the four inputs, the scarcity state, and each input times the state; fitted at each refit block on the earlier scored days that were not risk dates, whose outcome was observable at the block's fit and whose inputs and state are all public; it serves the block's days that are not risk dates
variant_rules.risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+offday_mon: (b) as (a), in the gradient-boosted form (ml.PRESSURE_CLASSIFIER_SETTINGS: a HistGradientBoostingClassifier) on the four inputs and the state, with a monotone constraint of +1 on the state, so that a scarcer state never lowers the forecast; the interaction is the trees' own
variant_rules.risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll+offday_rat: (c) chosen from step 1: as (a), with one more input, the rate of pressure days at the threshold over the 60 most recent earlier scored days that were not risk dates and whose outcome was observable at the block's fit (the rate #610's +recent_floor forecasts, the only row of step 1 whose pooled figures separate from the climatology at every lead). A day has the block's rate; nothing is read until 60 such days exist

inputs.tail_level: the SOFR 99th percentile less IORB (bp, sofr_p99_iorb_bps), at its latest public row
inputs.tail_change_5: that read less the read 5 scored days earlier; both public at the day's decision instant
inputs.dispersion_p99_p1: the SOFR 99th percentile less the 1st (percentage points), at their latest public row
inputs.satiation_distance: the rolling satiation distance of #587 (satiation_dist_roll), built per H.4.1 release as #622 requires
inputs.scarcity_state: the reserve-scarcity state 0 to 3 as of the decision instant, each leg at its own latest public row (#586); a day whose state is unknown is not served

inputs_reading: each input is read at the decision instant of the day's own lead through asof.InformationRule, on the 'both' arm of #541 (settlements dated from the auction announcement, the H.4.1 per release), with the leakage and staleness guards of baseline._as_of_folds. The days that train a block are the same days read at their own decision instants. No outcome after the block's fit enters a training label or the trailing rate
satiation_distance_version: built per H.4.1 release (scripts/off_risk_day_624.py panel), as #622 requires; #623 had not landed. It differs from the old-lag build (scripts/satiation_distance_598.py panel) on the rows #622 counts. The parent row's own forecasts are #598's, on the old-lag build, unchanged

constants.searched: none: every constant is #606's or #610's, declared before any scoring
constants.fit: a block is fitted only when its training pairs number minimum_pairs and hold minimum_events pressure days at the threshold, and not every pair is a pressure day; else its days are 0

off_risk_rule: a scored day for which announcement_dating_rescore.risk_flag(splits, values, True) is false, as in #606 and #610
cadence: the judge's: a refit every 21 scored days from 61 days of history
monotone_in_threshold: the curve across +5 and +10 bp is made non-increasing afterwards (probability_calibration.monotone_curves), as every row's is
no_hindsight_regimes: no regime label enters a fit; the scarcity state is read as of the decision instant (ruling on #515). The back-filled 2014-2018 history is not used (the guard of #572)
variants_declared: these three; no other variant, input, window, constant or form
judge: the judge as in force on main (metadata/pressure_judge.json, unchanged), under the weighted rule in force and the flat rule beside it
pairing: each variant against risk_gbm+settle+h41+dist_roll and against +tailcap75, with 90% stationary-bootstrap intervals, split by regime and pressure-day type
reports: tier 1 pooled and per lead, tiers 3 and 5, under the weighted rule with the flat rule beside it
on the days that are not risk dates: AUROC, Brier skill against the walk-forward climatology, the reliability slope and intercept (scripts/off_risk_day_624.py measure, step 1's declaration)
onsets kept and lost by date, against the parent and against +tailcap75
a variant that passes a tier through its mean only is reported as such: the off-risk-day discrimination is read beside the verdict
ruling_567: these variants were built after seeing 2018-2025; a pass is not a confirmation, and a variant can replace a shortlist slot only by Eleonora's decision before the 2026 window opens
published: nothing; no variant joins any published declaration
